أستعرض (form X)
# أَسْتَعْرِضُ (ʔastaʕriḍu) /ʔas.taʕ.ri.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
# أُسْتَعْرَضُ (ʔustaʕraḍu) /ʔus.taʕ.ra.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
# أَسْتَعْرِضَ (ʔastaʕriḍa) /ʔas.taʕ.ri.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
# أُسْتَعْرَض
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
